# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do the invented learning-garden context notes report about program sessions?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records supplied in the invented fixture (fixture-001.json) describing learning-garden or harbor program context notes.
- Any year, English.

## Exclusion criteria
- Any record not present in the supplied fixture.

## Query log
| Date | Backend | Query | Hits |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-07 | invented-index (supplied fixture) | all records in fixture-001.json | 2 |

No live backends were queried. All records are entirely invented and carry no DOI, arXiv ID, or PMID.

## Screening
Both records included at title/abstract stage. Full text supplied for each.

## Retrieval summary
2 full-text / 0 abstract-only. No papers missing.
The amber garden note described 42% of sessions (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor note described few of sessions (Vale, 2024).
